name: Caso 3 - Independencia cliente facturacion vs persona de retiro (Envio a)

planSteps.description: Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4200 (login page)

Click 'Iniciar Sesión con Microsoft'. On the Microsoft page type 'desarrollopy@pycca.com', click 'Next', type the password 'cdPY2027!*', click 'Sign in', and click 'Yes' if a 'Stay signed in?' prompt appears
The authenticated POS dashboard is visible (cards 'Facturación', 'Entrega de Caja', 'Historial de impresión')

PRECONDITION: click 'IR' on 'Facturación'. If a red notification says 'No puede acceder a esta funcionalidad porque tiene entregas de caja pendientes', go back to the dashboard, open 'Entrega de Caja', click 'Procesar', complete the 'Autorización de Administrador' modal by typing the exact text '%21310300;432940;JAIME GABRIEL HURTADO ALVAREZ' into the 'Tarjeta de administrador' field followed by Enter (the leading '%' and the Enter are mandatory), then type '1979' in 'Clave de administrador' and click 'Confirmar'. Accept the success dialog and retry opening Facturación until it opens

load 10 articles: for each SKU (O22652, O22654, O22655, O22657, O22955, O22976, O22977, O22978, O22979, O23546) type it into the 'Buscar producto por SKU' field and press Enter; after each one set its row quantity to 3 and press Tab. If an article shows a red 'Pendiente' label, click it and fill every field (Homologacion='HOM-2026-001', Imei='359747505623812', Marca='GENERICA', Modelo='MODELO-TEST') then click 'Continuar'

Tick the header checkbox of the product table to select all items, then click the future-delivery button in the toolbar (calendar icon) and complete the 'Autorización de Administrador' modal: type the exact text '%21310300;432940;JAIME GABRIEL HURTADO ALVAREZ' into the 'Tarjeta de administrador' field followed by pressing Enter (the leading '%' and the Enter are mandatory; without them the app answers 'Formulario incompleto: cardNumber, frameData'), then type '1979' into 'Clave de administrador' and click 'Confirmar'
The app navigates to the 'Entrega futura' screen (/pos-ui/delivery) showing an 'Envío a' panel on the right
CLIENTE B (persona de retiro): in the 'Envío a' panel type the cedula '2450681438' and click its search button
'Envío a' shows the customer for cedula 2450681438

Configure the delivery: for every product set its delivery quantity, clear the 'Buscar tienda' field so the store list appears and assign the quantity to the first store, pick any enabled future date in the calendar, and fill 'Teléfono de referencia' with '0991234567'. Then click 'Continuar' to return to Facturación
CLIENTE A (facturación): in the invoice screen type the cedula '0919522151' into 'Buscar cliente' and click its search button

Re-enter the delivery screen: tick the product checkbox, click the calendar (future-delivery) button and complete the 'Autorización de Administrador' modal: type the exact text '%21310300;432940;JAIME GABRIEL HURTADO ALVAREZ' into the 'Tarjeta de administrador' field followed by pressing Enter (the leading '%' and the Enter are mandatory; without them the app answers 'Formulario incompleto: cardNumber, frameData'), then type '1979' into 'Clave de administrador' and click 'Confirmar'. NOTE: re-entering always requires authorization again
KEY ASSERTION 1: 'Envío a' STILL shows cedula 2450681438 — changing the billing customer did NOT modify the pickup person
CLIENTE D: click the clear (X) button on the 'Envío a' customer card, then type the cedula '0914880208' and click search
'Envío a' now shows cedula 0914880208
Fill 'Teléfono de referencia' with '0991234567' and click 'Continuar'
KEY ASSERTION 2: back in Facturación the billing customer is STILL cedula 0919522151 — changing the pickup person did NOT modify the billing customer

Close the sale: click 'Continuar', select 'EFECTIVO', click 'Agregar', click 'Continuar'. If a 'Seleccionar regalo' modal appears, pick the first product and click 'Aceptar', then cover the remaining balance with another EFECTIVO payment and click 'Continuar' again. Click 'Procesar', fill 'Recibido' with the amount shown in 'Pagar', press Tab and click 'Aceptar'
A 'Transacción finalizada' confirmation is shown (an 'Impresora no encontrada' notice is expected and can be ignored)

Go back to the dashboard, open 'Historial de impresión', select the row whose type is 'ENTREGA MERCADERIA (F4)' with its radio button, click 'Imprimir' and complete the 'Autorización de Administrador' modal: type the exact text '%21310300;432940;JAIME GABRIEL HURTADO ALVAREZ' into the 'Tarjeta de administrador' field followed by pressing Enter (the leading '%' and the Enter are mandatory; without them the app answers 'Formulario incompleto: cardNumber, frameData'), then type '1979' into 'Clave de administrador' and click 'Confirmar'

KNOWN DEFECT D-01: the system answers 'No hay documentos para imprimir' even though the voucher row is selected, while the FACTURA row does reach the printer driver ('Impresora no encontrada'). Report whether this defect is still present
